name: Early bird
summary: Buyers in the first minutes of a coin pay a share of the pool's fee. After that the pool charges its normal fee.
rules: For a set number of slots after the pool is created, a buy pays only a share of the pool's own fee.
After that window the hook answers nothing, and every buy pays the normal pool fee.
It never takes a fee for anyone.
The pool never calls it on a sell.
The window and the share are set at launch. Nobody can change them afterwards.
author: The hook kit

args.name: window_slots
args.label: Early window
args.help: How long the lower fee lasts, counted from the pool's creation. A slot is about 0.4 seconds, so 750 slots are about 5 minutes.

args.name: discount_bps
args.label: Share of the pool fee an early buyer pays
args.help: 50 means an early buyer pays half of the pool fee. 0 means none of it.
